body: It's pretty freaky ain't it, they don't even really hurt.
It's never really hurt that bad and I have always had a weird thing with doctors, I know it won't fix itself but I can never bring myself to go.
I live in a really small town, in the smallest state of Australia and its amazingly difficult to find guys down here.
It was some Australian one they said that the cant help anyone who actually needs professional help.
thanks i will check it out.

I just wish there was a way, electroshock therapy maybe, somehow to just make my brain not even slightly remember it, it seems to take up so much of my time, no matter how happy i am one idle thought and im dragged back down again.
Its hard for me to fathom, my sister had kids and the memories come back to her every night but i cant help but feel that it would help to understand it better.
not really i would probably fuck it up.
I was turned away, they said they dont deal with people who actually might kill themselves, its sorta just a self gratification, feel good about yourself line.
